learning_outcomes.text: Students know the essential methods and procedures of technical documentation and technical communication, and are familiar with the corresponding specialized vocabulary.
Students are able to create standard-compliant representations of technical elements and components.
Students are able to generate technical, manufacturing-compliant drawings, as well as to review technical drawings and derive technical relationships.
Students know the physical, mechanical, and material-technical relationships in technical drawings.
Students have basic knowledge of the interaction of machine elements.
Students can operate 3D CAD software for the creation of components, assemblies, and technical drawings.
Students are able to design components according to functional, manufacturing, assembly, and measurement requirements.
Students know the engineering scientific fundamentals in the field of engineering design.
Students can explain, check, or independently develop technical drawings.
Students practiced initial approaches to model building of assemblies and components in software.
Students can transfer knowledge/skills to specific mechanical engineering/engineering scientific problems.

syllabus_topics: Fundamentals of sketching as a basic engineering skill
Fundamentals of technical standardization in general
Representation contents of general and workshop drawings
Application of 3D CAD software for component, assembly, and technical drawing creation
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded for a passed written exam (grade).
